title: Weekly English Review
summary: This week saw significant developments in the financial and tech sectors, with Reddit's stock plunging 29% after disappointing sales projections, marking its worst day ever. Ryanair's CEO warned of potential fare increases of up to 20% due to escalating fuel costs, highlighting the financial pressures on airlines. Meanwhile, Meta announced plans to raise up to $25 billion through a bond sale to boost investments in artificial intelligence, reflecting the growing demand for AI solutions. Additionally, tensions between the U.S. and Iran have raised concerns about oil supply disruptions, with predictions of prices exceeding $100. These events underscore the interconnectedness of global markets and the impact of geopolitical factors on economic conditions.
